name: Injoku no Seiki ~Kaikan ni Ochita Hime~
original_name: 淫辱の性姫～快姦二堕チタ姫～
source:
Grados has a grudge against elves since his parents were persecuted by them. One day, he meets Norun, a monster.
"Why don't you take revenge on them? I'll help you."
Grados finally decides to take action...

By using Norun's power, he and his company successfully take their castle. They soon excute the King and there are the Queen and her daughter...

"Just kill us!" However, Grados says,

"Kill you? No, I won't. I'll just humiliate you..." 

[From Himeya Shop]
